id: title:TueHaulund:tolerate long beginframe stalls in the recording rasterizer

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a soft warning and recovery logging for rasterization stalls in session replay, while retaining existing hard timeouts; relevant to PostHog's session replay and recording stability.
review.reason: The change introduces a new stall-metric and soft warning behavior alongside an existing hard timeout, supported by updated tests. This represents a substantive, bounded improvement in recording reliability and diagnostics.
review.uncertainty: The actual production benefit and user impact are not demonstrated; this is a code implementation without verified outcomes.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No missing context or truncation. No score assigned yet.
